title: Unlevel out of the box, but functional with some tweaking.
text:
Unlevel out of the box, but functional with some tweaking.. I may have actually found a shower caddy that I can live with despite an actual manufacturer flaw. Taking this out of the package, I noticed that it wasn't level. It actually tilts a bit to one side and the shelves aren't level. See the photo.

It doesn't actually hang on my shower head properly because we have a marble ledge along the wall exactly where the suction cups are and it makes the entire unit bow out. Plus there's that whole uneven, tilting problem. Since it does hold the large size shampoo bottles, I found a work around.

I took pliers are turned the top hook a quarter turn around hung it on the shower glass wall using the suction cups on the glass. I had to think about placement of my items to keep stuff from sliding - pesky tilt. However, almost two weeks now and the suction cups are holding with no trouble & it's working fine. Nonetheless, the final production quality needs closer scrutiny.
